values.value: Amendment price drift from original sold price

Finds: SBQQ__QuoteLine__c records linked to a prior line via SBQQ__Source__c whose current SBQQ__NetPrice__c is more than 5% off the original line's NetPrice. Why it matters: This is the upstream signature of Q-to-O variance on amendments (ORD-FOR-003). The amendment flow pulled current pricebook list price instead of preserving the originally negotiated price. Downstream effects: billing kickbacks, customer disputes, accounting rework, and credit memos. The original negotiation is lost on every amendment unless the price is manually corrected back. Suppress a finding: when the price delta represents a deliberate uplift, mid-term repricing, or contracted adjustment. Note the reason and dismiss. Disable the detector: only if your business intentionally re-prices on every amendment.
Review {N} amendment lines with >5% drift from original price
